blocks.content:
This local-only guide exercises every selector changed in `interactive.styles.ts`, including the shared `.interactive-feedback-box` variants (`--neutral` / `--warning` / `--info` / `--success` / `--muted`). Styles apply on ContentRenderer mounts only (sidebar, floating, fullscreen, guide-reader, editor preview).

Use **Reset guide** between passes. §1–3 layout. §4–5 requirement neutrals. §6 executing. §7 error/cancel (warning + muted). §8 mark-complete. §9 forced failures. **§10 feedback-box spray** — quiz / code / terminal / challenge emitters for every semantic variant.
Exercise the state-dependent card padding, counter position, action spacing, and section completion treatment.

**Active → completed.** Before clicking, verify the content and Show me / Do it buttons share a compact vertical rhythm. Click **Do it** to produce the green completed bubble and confirm equal internal padding on all four sides.
blocks.tooltip: This step targets its own card so it can complete without changing Grafana.

blocks.content: **Requirement → skipped.** First compare the compact requirement box and its buttons. Then click **Skip** and verify the blue skipped bubble uses the same internal padding and number alignment as the completed bubble.
blocks.hint: The target is intentionally absent so the requirement and Skip states remain available.

blocks.content: **Section completion.** Click **Do it**, then compare the completed section's outer padding, step gaps, number positions, and action row with its incomplete state.
blocks.tooltip: Completing this step finishes the section.

blocks.content: Compare numbered plain content with every major self-padded or flush interactive card.
**Plain markdown, short.** Its number and text should use balanced left/right padding and the same inter-item gap as cards.

**Plain markdown, wrapping.** This deliberately longer sentence should wrap early enough to make asymmetric horizontal padding obvious; the text column should remain visually centered within the section.
**After unnumbered media.** Numbering must continue (this is the next number after the wrapping markdown, skipping the image).
**Noop / informational.** No action buttons — the action row must collapse via `:has()` rather than leaving empty vertical space.
**Show-only.** Only **Show me** — confirm the shared action-button padding still applies when Do it is hidden.
**Interactive step.** This is the flush, incomplete `.interactive-step` case.
**Multistep inside a section.** Number + Start/Skip padding; complete it to inspect the completed badge padding inside a numbered card.
**Guided inside a section.** Number + idle Start/Skip; optionally run to inspect executing / completed chrome on a numbered card.

## 3. Standalone interactives (no section)

These blocks mount at guide root — no numbers, no section gap, and component-owned margins stay intact. Compare consecutive `.interactive-step` cards: they must keep vertical separation. Also complete and skip the first two to verify terminal-state padding outside a section.

Also include a **noop** and **show-only** card here so the empty-actions `:has()` rule and single-button padding are checked outside a section.
**Standalone noop.** No buttons; action chrome must not reserve vertical space.
**Standalone show-only.** Single Show me button with shared horizontal padding.
**Standalone interactive → completed.** Confirm Show me / Do it spacing, then **Do it**. The completed bubble must self-pad without a section wrapper.
**Standalone interactive → skipped.** Confirm the requirement box, then **Skip**. The skipped bubble must match the completed card's internal padding and keep separation from neighbors.

blocks.content: **Standalone interactive, still active.** Leave this incomplete so you can compare flush active cards against the completed and skipped bubbles above.
**Standalone multistep.** Verify its outer margin against neighboring interactive cards and that Start / Skip padding matches the shared action-button rule.

Standalone terminal: Copy / Exec should keep their own padding; card spacing should not collapse.
Standalone terminal-connect: spacing only — do not start a VM.

## 4. Requirement-box palette (also standalone)

These intentionally fail their requirements at guide root. Each should render `.interactive-feedback-box.interactive-feedback-box--neutral` (shared **4px 12px** padding) even though internal layouts and controls differ. See §10 for warning / info / success / muted emitters.
**Regular step requirement.** Contains explanation, spinner when checking, and retry/skip controls inside the box.
**Multistep requirement.** This variant contains explanation text without the regular step's full control body.
**Guided requirement.** Its explanation and spinner are inside the box while fix controls render below it.
This content remains gated; inspect the lock banner above it.

Click **Do Section** (or each step's **Do it**) and inspect `.interactive-step.executing` border/glow, internal card gap, Cancel in `.interactive-guided-executing`, and action-button padding before completion. After the section finishes it auto-collapses — expand or use Reset to inspect `.interactive-section-actions.collapsed`.
Step A — complete first; watch executing chrome mid-run.
Step B — second runner step; same executing + Cancel pass.

## 7. Guided / multistep error and cancel

Start each block, then cancel mid-run or let the second substep fail (missing target). Inspect `.interactive-guided-cancelled-actions`, `.interactive-guided-error-actions`, Retry/Skip/AI padding, and the completed Redo row after a successful path.
**Guided error + cancel.** Start the tour, cancel on the first substep (or continue into the failing second). Restart into the failing target to expose error-actions padding.

steps.description: Intentionally missing — triggers error actions row.

blocks.content: **Multistep error.** Run steps; the second substep fails so you can inspect error-actions and Redo padding.
No interactive children — only **Mark section as complete** in `.interactive-section-actions`. After acknowledging, inspect collapsed Reset padding if the section auto-collapses.

These omit blocking `exists-reftarget` (or use a verify that can never pass) so **Do it** / **Start** stays clickable and the failure chrome appears on purpose. Use **Skip** / **Reset** between attempts.
**Immediate miss.** No requirements — click **Do it** (or Show me). Expect `.interactive-step-lazy-error` with “Element not found…” plus Retry.
blocks.hint: Target is intentionally absent so Do it fails immediately.

blocks.content: **Lazy-scroll stall then fail.** Click **Do it** — progressive scroll hunts inside the guide content, then lands on the same lazy-error chrome (“Element not found after scrolling…”).

blocks.content: **Post-verify fail.** Highlight succeeds on this card, then `verify` fails → `.interactive-step-execution-error` (not the lazy-error row).

**Multistep immediate fail.** Run — first substep missing → error-actions padding.

Every compact status blob should use `.interactive-feedback-box` + a variant (`--neutral` / `--warning` / `--info` / `--success` / `--muted`) with shared **4px 12px** padding. Component-local classes only add layout or intentional accents (e.g. challenge hint left bar). Work top-to-bottom; leave the gate step incomplete until you have inspected the sequential quiz block.

### Neutral (already covered above too)
§4–5 + regular/multistep/guided requirement boxes. Below: code + terminal **warning** requirement shells (same padding as neutral, warning palette).

### Warning — Complete previous step + Skip
Leave the gate incomplete. Every block below should show **Complete previous step** with **Skip** inside the same feedback blob (or the step requirement row). Shared **4px 12px** padding.

**Step: Complete previous step + Skip.** Footprints requirement blob (`--neutral`) must include the Skip control in `.interactive-step-requirement-buttons`.

After inspecting sequential blocks above, you may complete or Skip the gate and continue.

blocks.content:
### Muted / warning from guided (cross-check §7 & §9)
- **Muted:** cancel a guided tour mid-run → Tour cancelled (`--muted`).
- **Warning compound:** guided/multistep error box with title + detail.
- **Neutral:** requirement boxes in §4–5; sequential Complete previous step above.
- **Form checking + hint:** §9 formfill against the in-guide input.
- **Execution / lazy errors:** §9 immediate miss, lazy stall, post-verify.

### Info — alignment banner (environment)
`.interactive-section-alignment-banner` (`--info` + left accent) only appears when an implied-0th-step alignment prompt is active. If you can trigger alignment on this Grafana build, inspect that banner's padding against quiz revealed above; otherwise treat quiz revealed as the primary `--info` sample.
**Guided cancel → muted.** Start, then **Cancel** immediately to land on Tour cancelled (`--muted`). Restart into the missing target for the warning error box.

Missing — warning error box after restart.

blocks.content:
## Surface pass

After the sidebar, repeat at minimum in **floating**, **fullscreen**, and **editor preview**. Focus on §3 (standalone), §6–9 (executing / error-cancel / forced failures), and **§10 feedback-box spray** (every `--neutral` / `--warning` / `--info` / `--success` / `--muted` sample). Check narrow + wide widths, light + dark, and confirm non-guide UI (copy buttons, quiz choices, terminal controls, native links) kept original padding.
